mapper.select: SELECT a.*, u.nickname as userName, am.member_name as memberName FROM appointment a LEFT JOIN user u ON a.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN service_member am ON a.member_id = am.id WHERE a.member_id = #{memberId} ORDER BY a.appointment_date DESC

SELECT a.*, u.nickname as userName, am.member_name as memberName FROM appointment a LEFT JOIN user u ON a.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN service_member am ON a.member_id = am.id WHERE a.admin_id = #{adminId} ORDER BY a.appointment_date DESC

SELECT a.*, u.nickname as userName, am.member_name as memberName FROM appointment a LEFT JOIN user u ON a.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN service_member am ON a.member_id = am.id WHERE a.service_type = #{serviceType} AND a.date = #{date} AND a.status != 'cancelled' ORDER BY a.time_slot

SELECT a.*, u.nickname as userName, am.member_name as memberName FROM appointment a LEFT JOIN user u ON a.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN service_member am ON a.member_id = am.id WHERE a.date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} ORDER BY a.date, a.time_slot

SELECT a.*, u.nickname as userName, am.member_name as memberName FROM appointment a LEFT JOIN user u ON a.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN service_member am ON a.member_id = am.id WHERE a.status = #{status} ORDER BY a.appointment_date DESC
